name: MAPbI3 (110)-oriented bulk cell, 96 atoms
description: Periodic bulk cell of methylammonium lead iodide (CH3NH3PbI3) with 8 formula units (8 Pb, 8 methylammonium cations, 24 I) and no vacuum region. Cell is about 12.31 x 12.83 x 12.32 Angstrom. It is the 48-atom tetragonal cell re-expressed with axes along the [110] and [1-10] diagonals of the ab plane plus the c axis, and it was used to cut the (110) slab.

calculation.notes: Species order in the file is C, N, H, Pb, I (8, 8, 48, 8, 24 atoms); match the POTCAR order accordingly. Direct coordinates, no selective dynamics. The original header line reads 'MAPI Tetragonal (800 eV)'. The functional, dispersion correction, k-points and whether the structure is relaxed are not recorded in the file; add them here if known.

permissions: Own structure, created by the repository owner.
notes: Periodic cell with no vacuum along any axis (largest empty gap about 2 Angstrom), so it is a bulk cell and not a slab. The (110) label refers to the surface normal: the z axis of this cell lies along the [110] direction of the 48-atom tetragonal cell. The (110) slab in this library was cut from this cell.
transformation: New cell axes (a, b, c of the 96-atom file) = (-a+b), c, (a+b) of the 48-atom tetragonal cell. All six cell parameters of the 96-atom file match this transformation of the 48-atom cell, and the volume is exactly twice as large. Atomic positions were not compared.
